Who is Shri Swami Shashwat Acharya Ji Maharaj, the 19-year-old spiritual storyteller from Vrindavan who has become the internet's latest obsession?
From comments like "Radhe Radhe Daddy", "Pookie Baba" and "Facecardaeshwar" to thousands of social media reactions, Shashwat Acharya Ji Maharaj has emerged as one of the most talked-about young religious personalities online.
But there is much more to his story than his viral looks and Gen Z fan following.
